questions.question: List all the study populations (unit of analysis) for these papers. Output as JSON: {"study_population": ["<study_population>", ...]}
List all the countries where these studies was conducted. Convert cities/regions to country names (e.g., 'London'->'United Kingdom'). Output as JSON: {"country": ["<country>",...]}
List all independent variables (predictors/causes) investigated. Output as JSON: {"independent_variables": ["<independent_variable1>", "<independent_variable2>", ...]}
List all dependent variables (outcomes/effects) investigated. Output as JSON: {"dependent_variables": ["<dependent_variables1>", "<dependent_variables2>", ...]}
List the sample sizes for all studies. Output as JSON: {"sample_size": ["<sample_size>" or null,...]}
List all the statistical methods used to quantify the association between two variables. Output as JSON: {"statistical_method": ["<statistical_method>",...]}
List all the study population and the corresponding sample sizes. Output as JSON: {"study_population__sample": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "sample_size": "<sample_size>"}, ...]}

List all the study populations and the corresponding countries where these studies were conducted. Output as JSON: {"study_population__country": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "country": "<country>"}, ...]}

List all the independent variables with its measurement units. Output as JSON: {"independent_variable__unit": [{"independent_variable": "<independent_variable>", "independent_variable_unit": "<independent_variable_unit>"}, ...]}

List all the dependent variables with its measurement units. Output as JSON: {"dependent_variable__unit": [{"dependent_variable": "<dependent_variable>", "dependent_variable_unit": "<dependent_variable_unit>"}, ...]}

List all pairs of independent and dependent variables. Output as JSON: {"independent_variable__dependent_variable": [{"independent_variable": "<independent_variable>", "dependent_variable": "<dependent_variable>"}, ...]}

List all study populations and their sample sizes, along with the corresponding countries where these studies were conducted. Output as JSON: {"study_population__sample__country": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "sample_size": "<sample_size>", "country": "<country>"}, ...]}

List all study populations and their sample sizes, along with the independent variables. Output as JSON: {"study_population__sample__independent_variable": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "sample_size": "<sample_size>", "independent_variable": "<independent_variable>"}, ...]}

List all study populations and their sample sizes, along with the statistical methods used to quantify the association between two variables. Output as JSON: {"study_population__sample__statistical_method": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "sample_size": "<sample_size>", "statistical_method": "<statistical_method>"}, ...]}

List all study populations, independent and dependent variables, and the reported effect sizes. Output as JSON: {"study_population__independent_variable__dependent_variable__effect_size": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "independent_variable": "<independent_variable>", "dependent_variable": "<dependent_variable>", "effect_size": "<effect_size>"}, ...]}

List all study populations, independent and dependent variables, along with the statistical methods and effect sizes. Output as JSON: {"study_population__independent_variable__dependent_variable__statistical_method__effect_size": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "independent_variable": "<independent_variable>", "dependent_variable": "<dependent_variable>", "statistical_method": "<statistical_method>", "effect_size": "<effect_size>"}, ...]}
List the paper counts for each distinct study population. Output as JSON: {"study_population_counts": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "paper_count": <n>}, ...]}
List the paper counts for each distinct country. Output as JSON: {"country_counts": [{"country": "<country>", "paper_count": <n>}, ...]}
Calculate the average sample size across all studies. Output as JSON: {"average_sample_size": <value>}

List the paper counts for each (study population, country) pair. Output as JSON: {"study_population__country_counts": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "country": "<country>", "paper_count": <n>}, ...]}

List the paper counts for each (study population, country) pair for studies with a sample size greater than 100. Output as JSON: {"study_population__country_counts_gt100": [{"study_population": "<study_population>", "country": "<country>", "paper_count": <n>}, ...]}

tiers.1: Single variable extraction: f(X), Count(X) where X ∈ {P, G, IV, DV, N, M}
